$purpose: The plugins installed in Launch (D31, docs/CONCEPTS.md §16). `pnpm plugin add|upgrade|remove|list|check` (scripts/plugin.mjs, the /launch-plugin skill) read and write this file: each installed plugin is a surface with the repository, version and commit it came from. Launch was seeded from the Rocketflare kit but does not track kit releases; this file tracks plugins only. Never edit it by hand.
$kitVersion: The Rocketflare release whose plugin API Launch implements (it was seeded from it). A plugin declares the oldest kit it supports as `minKit`, and `pnpm plugin` checks it against this value rather than against Launch's own version.
$app: Launch's names. A plugin is written in the kit's vocabulary and translated into these on the way in.
